easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a nonland permanent with an equal or lesser mana value than the one you wish to donate.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Puca's Mischief triggers.
In response, cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Old Fat Spider.
Resolve the Puca's Mischief trigger, exchanging control of a nonland permanent an opponent controls with equal or lesser mana value and Old Fat Spider.
Activate the ability granted to Old Fat Spider by Martyrdom an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Old Fat Spider triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
